column1: # Slice 18 (plan/headers.md section 4): libniji's _FORTIFY_SOURCE wrappers, one row per fortified name. Read by the
# `@@fortify` marker (xtask/src/headers/slices/s18.rs). This table holds libniji's design only; the ABI facts come
# from spec/abi: the symbol each call references and the levels it does so at (callsites.tsv, mode call/macro), the
# wrapped function's prototype (prototypes.tsv) and the `_chk` prototype (chk-prototypes.tsv, C.9).
# form     builtin: the wrapper returns GCC's `__builtin___<x>_chk` (GCC manual, Object Size Checking), which folds
#                   to the plain call when the size is unknown or the call provably fits; `args` lists its arguments.
#          chk:     the wrapper calls the `_chk` symbol with `args`, except when the destination's size is unknown
#                   (the plain call) or `safe` holds at compile time (the plain call).
#          va:      the wrapper always calls the `_chk` symbol (no destination size: the printf family's flag).
#          redirect: the declaration binds to the `_chk` symbol by asm label (longjmp family).
#          macro:   a C.9 macro whose index computation calls the `_chk` symbol (FD_*: `__fdelt_chk (d)`).
# args     the `_chk` call's arguments (C.9: the destination size appended, the printf family's flag inserted):
#          $N the wrapper's parameter N; $SN the object size of parameter N in bytes; $EN the same in elements of
#          parameter N's pointee; $F the flag (1 at levels 2 and 3, else 0); $V the variadic arguments
#          (__builtin_va_arg_pack); any other word is C text (`stdout`).
# safe     (form chk) a C condition, over the same tokens, that is true when the call cannot write past the
#          destination; `-` for none (the `_chk` symbol is called whenever the size is known).
# ost      the object-size type at levels 2 and 3 (GCC: 0 the whole object, 1 the closest enclosing subobject);
#          level 1 uses 0 throughout. 1 only for the NUL-terminated string writers.
